name: magic-ui-marquee
title: Marquee
description: A horizontal ticker of testimonial cards, duplicated enough times to loop seamlessly; the two demo rows glide opposite ways and freeze when hovered.
use: A wall of social proof should keep moving to show volume without taking more height.
avoid: Fewer than about six items: the loop repeats the same cards visibly.
a11y: Pauses on hover only, so keyboard users cannot stop the motion, and it keeps moving with no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two stacked rows of small dark review cards with rounded corners and thin borders, each holding a round avatar, a name, a handle and a short quote. The rows run edge to edge on black and fade out at the sides.
behaves: Each row slides sideways on a loop, the two rows moving in opposite directions. Hovering a row freezes it until the pointer leaves.
customise: Direction, vertical mode, repeat count, pause-on-hover and duration are props or CSS variables; the card content is whatever you pass as children.
weight: light: A handful of duplicated card siblings moved by one CSS transform keyframe.
